tours.name: Create and Assign a Contract
tours.description: Learn how to create an employment contract for an employee: give it a reference, assign it to the employee, enter the wage, save it, and start it.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to create an employment contract for an employee: give it a reference, assign it to the employee, enter the wage, save it, and start it.

steps.title: Open Employees
steps.description: Contracts are managed from the Employees app. A contract links an employee to their pay, working schedule and dates of employment.

description_i18n.en_US: Contracts are managed from the Employees app. A contract links an employee to their pay, working schedule and dates of employment.

steps.title: Employees menu
steps.description: The Employees menu groups the lists you use most often, including the list of contracts.

description_i18n.en_US: The Employees menu groups the lists you use most often, including the list of contracts.

steps.title: Contracts
steps.description: This list shows every contract in the company, with its status. Use it to check who is covered by a contract and when it ends.

description_i18n.en_US: This list shows every contract in the company, with its status. Use it to check who is covered by a contract and when it ends.

steps.title: New contract
steps.content: Click New to create a contract.

content_i18n.en_US: Click New to create a contract.

steps.description: The New button opens a blank contract form. The contract is only stored once you save it.

description_i18n.en_US: The New button opens a blank contract form. The contract is only stored once you save it.

steps.title: Contract reference
steps.content: Type a reference for the contract, then press Tab.

content_i18n.en_US: Type a reference for the contract, then press Tab.

steps.description: The reference identifies the contract in lists and on payslips. A common choice is the employee's name followed by the contract type, for example Jane Doe - Permanent.

description_i18n.en_US: The reference identifies the contract in lists and on payslips. A common choice is the employee's name followed by the contract type, for example Jane Doe - Permanent.

steps.title: Open Employee
steps.content: Click here to choose the employee.

content_i18n.en_US: Click here to choose the employee.

steps.description: The contract belongs to one employee. Choosing the employee also fills in their department and job position.

description_i18n.en_US: The contract belongs to one employee. Choosing the employee also fills in their department and job position.

steps.title: Choose the employee
steps.content: Click the employee this contract is for.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the employee this contract is for.

steps.description: Pick the employee from the list. If the person is not listed, create their employee record first. Start typing a name to narrow the list.

description_i18n.en_US: Pick the employee from the list. If the person is not listed, create their employee record first. Start typing a name to narrow the list.

steps.title: Monthly wage
steps.content: Type the monthly wage, then press Tab.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the monthly wage, then press Tab.

steps.description: The wage is the gross monthly salary used to calculate payslips. Enter the amount before any deductions.

description_i18n.en_US: The wage is the gross monthly salary used to calculate payslips. Enter the amount before any deductions.

steps.title: Save
steps.content: Click the save icon to keep the contract.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the save icon to keep the contract.

steps.description: Saving stores the contract. A new contract starts in the New status and does not affect payroll until you start it.

description_i18n.en_US: Saving stores the contract. A new contract starts in the New status and does not affect payroll until you start it.

steps.title: Start the contract
steps.content: Click Running to start the contract.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Running to start the contract.

steps.description: A contract only counts for payroll once it is Running. Starting it tells Odoo to use this wage and working schedule for the employee from the start date.

description_i18n.en_US: A contract only counts for payroll once it is Running. Starting it tells Odoo to use this wage and working schedule for the employee from the start date.

steps.title: Contract is running
steps.content: The contract is now running. Click the contract name to finish.

content_i18n.en_US: The contract is now running. Click the contract name to finish.

steps.description: The status bar now highlights Running, which means the contract is active and you can create payslips for this employee.

description_i18n.en_US: The status bar now highlights Running, which means the contract is active and you can create payslips for this employee.
